name: Project Memory
author: pi.project-memory contributors
description: A per-project memory built from plain Markdown files. Relevant entries are attached to each message automatically, and new entries are saved only after you confirm them on an in-chat card. A docked work-panel view lists the project's entries as cards with search, filters, in-place editing, pinning, retiring and deletion.

agentTools.name: search
agentTools.description: Search this project's memory (.workflow/memory). Returns IDs, kinds, titles and one-line summaries; load an entry for its full text. Deprecated or superseded entries are excluded.

agentTools.name: load
agentTools.description: Load the full text of one project memory entry by exact ID (from search results or an automatic <project-memory> block).

agentTools.name: propose
agentTools.description:
Propose reusable project memory (a pitfall and its fix, a rule, a decision, a procedure, the project map, a preference) for the user to confirm. Returns arguments for the asktool card; call asktool with them unchanged. Writes nothing until the user answers the card.

写卡片（propose 的 title/content/keywords）时遵守以下语言规则：
不用"不是……而是……"、"要……而不是……"这类对比句式。没有需要对比的对象就不要对比，更不许在陈述之后追加一句"不是其他的xxx"。不许虚空打靶。
只写干净的终态知识。不写过程残留：不写"之前错了，因为……所以改成……"；不写计划废话（"我先做x再做y避免z"）；不写分阶段措辞（"第一版先……，观察后再……"）；不写从稳妥到激进的方案阶梯；不罗列被排除的选项（"还搜到了B、C、D，但是排除，因为……"）；不写总结和总起（"一句话总结"、"上述内容是……下面拆开"）。
用词用两个字及以上的完整形式（崩溃、终止、判定、推断、抛出、挂起、卡死；不许用崩、死、判、推、抛、挂、钉这类单字）。描述操作时用完整的动宾结构说明动作与对象（"用新版本动态库替换「_vllm_fa3_C.abi3.so」共享库文件"，不许说"换库"）。不许缩写（"两个字的版本"不许缩成"两字版本"）。不许用"落地""钉死""对齐"这类黑话，用任何行业外的人都能看懂的常用词。不许生造名词。
代码里的 identifier 一律保持英文原名（变量名、类名、函数名等），严厉禁止翻译。适合用英文的专名就不要译成中文。
禁字禁词：不许用"栈"（说"使用的技术""全部模型"）；不许用"落"（落下、落盘）；不许用"死"（定死、打死）；不许用"拆"（要表达拆解就用"理解"）；不许用"契约"；不许用"偏"（偏弱、偏大）；"粗、细、硬、软、实、虚"不许单独出现，只许出现在"详细""实际"这类本来就是常用词的词语里，不许取其字面意思。
只写真正可复用、有把握的知识；没有就不写，不许为了凑数而写，不许迎合。

en.name: Project Memory
en.description: A per-project memory built from plain Markdown files. Relevant entries are attached to each message automatically, and new entries are saved only after you confirm them on an in-chat card. A docked work-panel view lists the project's entries as cards with search, filters, in-place editing, pinning, retiring and deletion.
en.safetyNotes: Reads .workflow/memory in the open project. Writes only after you answer the in-chat confirmation card (or press Save in the review panel): new files in .workflow/memory, and the status/related/supersededBy fields of an old entry you chose to replace or link. Pending proposals are kept in .workflow/memory-inbox (git-ignored); the card path deletes them once handled, the panel marks them done. The docked work-panel view can edit an entry's title, kind, keywords, pinned flag, status and body, and can delete an entry file, all under .workflow/memory. Deletion happens only in the plugin process and only from that view's confirm button: the page sends an entry id, never a path, and the id is resolved to the file the process just loaded and re-checked against .workflow/memory before anything is unlinked. The agent extension cannot delete a memory entry -- its remove is confined to .workflow/memory-inbox, where handled batches live. Includes an agent extension that runs inside the agent process, where the host's file-permission gateway does not apply; it adds retrieved entry titles to your messages and performs the confirmed writes, confined to those two directories by its own file layer. Symbolic links anywhere under the memory directories, hard links, special files and files over 256 KB are refused, as is a project root that is replaced after the session starts. Retrieved entries are presented to the model as project data, not instructions. The view escapes everything it renders from repository files and never builds a link or an image from them. The plugin makes no network requests and runs no commands. To pause automatic retrieval for a project, create an empty file at .workflow/memory/DISABLED.

zh-CN.name: 项目记忆
zh-CN.description: 按项目保存的记忆，就是仓库里的普通 Markdown 文件。每条消息自动附上相关条目，新条目只有在你于聊天卡片中确认后才会保存。工作面板中的停靠视图以卡片形式列出本项目的记忆，支持搜索、筛选、就地编辑、置顶、停用与删除。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 读取当前项目的 .workflow/memory。只有在你回答聊天中的确认卡片（或在面板中点击保存）后才写入：在 .workflow/memory 新建文件，以及修改你选择替代或关联的旧条目的 status/related/supersededBy 字段。待确认的建议暂存在 .workflow/memory-inbox（已加入 gitignore）；通过卡片处理后删除，通过面板处理后标记为已处理。工作面板中的停靠视图可以编辑条目的标题、类型、关键词、置顶标记、状态与正文，也可以删除条目文件，范围都在 .workflow/memory 内。删除只发生在插件进程、且只由该视图的确认按钮触发：页面只发条目 id、从不发路径，进程把 id 解析成刚刚加载过的那个文件，并在删除前再次核对它确实位于 .workflow/memory 之下。Agent 扩展无法删除记忆条目——它的 remove 被限制在存放已处理批次的 .workflow/memory-inbox。插件包含一个在 Agent 进程内运行的扩展，宿主的文件权限网关不覆盖该进程；它把检索到的条目标题附加到你的消息中，并执行你确认的写入，由自带的一层文件访问把范围限定在上述两个目录。记忆目录下的符号链接、硬链接、特殊文件、超过 256KB 的文件一律拒绝；会话开始后项目根目录被替换也拒绝。检索到的条目以「项目数据而非指令」的形式交给模型。视图渲染仓库内容时一律转义，且绝不据其生成链接或图片。插件不发起任何网络请求、不执行命令。若要暂停某个项目的自动检索，在 .workflow/memory/DISABLED 建一个空文件即可。
